notes.title: Our new video game Little Fighters on Stream
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[previewyoutube=CK2rTFLOdWg;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you're very well, we come to show you one of the games on we're working. Now it's Little Fighters on Stream. A video game in which the viewers of your stream can participate, by means of simple commands in the chat.
Go to the Little Fighters On Stream store here

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31581558/6f24072a1526133f01666485d4ff0700d47e7955.png

We'ill launch it as Early Access very soon. You can now add it to your wish list on Steam to be notified and you would also support us a lot with it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31581558/3675517d95c97d8f297143470ef596976c306a42.png

notes.title: 60 FPS/LANGUAGE UPDATE
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31581558/3c92d9f2b5df3ff436dd69f3c609cc93b95c2c3c.png
hi everyone! >:D
A long time whith not publish anything. We have been tremendously busy developing our new video game. We know that 60 fps is a standard in video games today, but back in the days when we're development Q-YO Blaster, we had no idea how to implement it. Here we present the changes that this update brings, among which is a small improvement to the translation.


60 FPS 
Language update
Fixed bugs


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31581558/a9d6f14fc6cc1ea30d1642b245e30cb92f8566de.gif
Soon there will be new things and a new adventure that we're developing. However, for Q-YO Blaster there will still be new things.

Thank you so much for playing Q-YO Blaster!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31581558/10951ee57812d422fd92ce20f82d14e035d4968c.png

notes.title: News
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31581558/5bf1f3681ac299a1faa4853395f07ea6f6e651ca.png
Hi everyone,

First of all, enjoy the offer that will be available shortly, or it may already is available.
Long time without publishing anything. 
However there is news that we would love to let you know.
First of all, we have ported the game on Nintendo Switch (with the help of a publisher obviously), this has helped us a lot to be much more visible among the players, we have adjusted and refined some errors, we have started new projects, that is, we are working on new videogames, however, we will not deviate from the subject.
The price of Q-YO Blaster had to be adjusted due to its release on Nintendo Switch, but that drives us to continue creating more content and putting up great offers of Q-YO Blaster. It also allows us to continue creating more content for Q-YO Blaster, below we will give you a list of things you can enjoy in future updates:

 "Missions" : It is a new game mode which contains new stages with their respective boss, however we must clarify that, the center point of the Stage will be the Boss

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31581558/d338116b9758ca46572faf0cd4568b8ff1b50a5c.gif

 Improved translation, this is a problem that we have never been able to completely solve, however we find it a bit difficult since English is not our mother tongue


 Solution of bugs and different errors


 Much more content that will be added with various updates

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31581558/4a9b266a4288fd348c6f9f62e075af0783ffed8c.gif
We plan to release the next update quite soon, even though we don't have the exact date yet, but it will be as soon as we can.
Without further ado, thank you very much for supporting us and for playing Q-YO Blaster!
See you soon!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31581558/10951ee57812d422fd92ce20f82d14e035d4968c.png
